response.why: Neither Preacher nor Sheoldred can block their fliers, so ground development alone won't stop the clock; Sheoldred's life-drain/life-gain engine (net ~4 life swing per draw cycle) is the strongest way to offset their 3-flying-damage-per-turn racing plan while also being a huge deathtouch threat they must answer.
response.plan: Land Sheoldred now to start swinging the life race back in my favor via its draw triggers; hold Preacher and Drowner in hand for next turn, using Drowner reactively to stun their best attacker if the race gets close.
